title: Pre-Market — Tuesday, Nov 24, 2026
html:
Asia bought Monday's Nvidia rally. New York is selling it back. SPY is $715.84 pre-market (−0.9%), which puts the S&P 500 near 7,173, back under Monday's 7,250–7,261 ceiling. The selling is in the names that bounced hardest: NVDA −5.5%, SMH −4.2%, QQQ −1.7%. Dell reports after the close; markets close Thursday for Thanksgiving and at 1 p.m. Friday.

What matters this morning

  • The chip bounce is fading: NVDA $155.90 (−5.5%) on your Nvidia 0.5 ($155.33); SMH $441.00 (−4.2%); MU −6.8%, DELL −6.1%, INTC −6.1%, BE −5.6%, CRDO −5.3%, AMD −4.1%.
  • Asia closed the other way: Taiex +9%+, Kospi +6.5% (5,014.41), Nikkei +3.9% (58,654.40), Hang Seng +0.2%.
  • Washington is the new pressure on chips: the administration told Nvidia it must ensure export-control compliance if Huang returns; Jeffries said Congress will "thoroughly investigate"; an Alibaba Singapore unit was blacklisted over AI chip transfers (BABA −2.8%).
  • Rates and oil quiet: 10-year about 4.93%, DXY about 104.3, WTI about $79.6–79.9, gold −0.4%. Williams: inflation "still too high."
  • Today: consumer confidence 10:00; Dell, HP, Workday after the close. PCE and GDP Wednesday.

Top 3 actionable

  1. GOOGL Dec 18 $270 put — on the trigger. GOOGL $279.56; entry a 15-minute close under $279.50; out over $285.20; target $265. R:R 2.5. $6.25/$6.50, OI 11,509. IV 41.5% vs moves 40.0% → FAIR.
  2. JPM Dec 18 $305 put — in the entry zone. JPM $316.51; out over $327; target $294.24. R:R 2.1. $4.65/$4.80, OI 2,409. IV 30.6% vs 22.7% → EXPENSIVE.
  3. BAC Dec 18 $47 put — 0.9% from the trigger. Entry a 15-minute close under $47.65; out over $48.60; target $45.64. R:R 2.1. $1.00/$1.08, OI 4,751. FAIR.

Overnight, and what it means

This is a positioning move, not a new scare: bonds, the dollar and oil barely moved while Monday's winners are sold (SMH −4.2%, equal-weight RSP flat). It confirms last night's force 2 (a short squeeze, not a new uptrend) and adds export controls and Congress as the new overhang for force 1. Force 3 (a hiking Fed) is unchanged.

My read: a lower, chip-led open; the S&P tests Monday's low (7,153) before 7,250 again. What would change my mind: NVDA back over $165 in the first hour, or SMH over $450.

What's going on

  1. Nvidia: the CEO is back, Washington wants a say. NVDA $155.90 (overnight low $154.83) after +31.5% Monday. Export-control compliance demand, a congressional probe, the Apex and Megaspeed blacklistings. Nothing new on the SEC review or the 10-Q due Dec 4.
  2. The squeeze unwinds where it was biggest. MU −6.8%, DELL −6.1%, INTC −6.1%; defensives bid (KO +1.0%, XOM +1.0%). HPE about −10%.
  3. A short week with Dell, PCE and a holiday. Dell is the AI-server read for SMH, NVDA, VRT and BE; IV-crush risk for anyone holding through it.

S&P 500 at the open

  • 7,364 (200-day 7,350 + 50% of the drop) · 7,261 / 7,250 (38.2% cluster) · ~7,173 pre-market · 7,153 Monday's low · 7,081 the 50% line
  • 14-day 7,405 · 30-day 7,553 · 50-day 7,618 · 200-day 7,350
  • If the S&P opens above 7,261… the selling got absorbed; next 7,350–7,364. Calls stay off.
  • If it holds between 7,153 and 7,261… digesting; act only on put ideas that trigger on their own lines (GOOGL, BAC).
  • If it opens below 7,153… Monday is being sold; 7,081 is next.

Movers on your list

GOOGL $279.56 (−0.9%) — on the trigger

  • $285.20 stop line · $284.72 14-day · $279.50 trigger · $271.77 old March low · $265.00 target 1 · $251.32 the desk's 0.5 ext

Downtrend since Oct 23; Monday's bounce stalled at the 14-day. Plan: a 15-minute close under $279.50, out over $285.20, target $265 (2.5 to 1).

NVDA $155.90 (−5.5%) — no trade

  • Your ladder: $201.24 1.382 · $170.22 0.786 · $155.33 0.5 · $129.31 0 · $117.03 −0.236. 14-day $165.56, 30-day $191.80.

Back on your 0.5. No trade: IV about 71%, the 10-Q (Dec 4) sits inside any December contract.

Others: INTC $56.03 (−6.1%, back under the 14-day), DELL $314.59 (−6.1%, reports tonight), PLTR $155.78 (−2.2%), ANT $83.00 (−5.3%, on its offer price), BE, CRDO, AMD, VRT −4% to −6%. Holding up: KO, XOM, OXY, TLT, AAPL, DAL.

Today's calendar

  • 10:00 Conference Board consumer confidence (November)
  • After close: DELL (IV-crush risk), HPQ, WDAY, AMBA
  • Wednesday: PCE, GDP. Thursday closed. Friday closes 1 p.m.

Alerts for today

  • S&P 500 — crosses below 7,153 → Monday's low is gone; 7,081 is next
  • S&P 500 — crosses above 7,261 → back over the 38.2% ceiling
  • GOOGL — crosses below $279.50 → the $270 put idea (wait for the 15-minute close)
  • BAC — crosses below $47.65 → the $47 put idea's trigger zone
  • NVDA — crosses below $155.33 → your 0.5 fails again
  • JPM — crosses above $327.00 → the JPM put idea is wrong

An alert means look now, not buy now.

Opening rule of the day

Let the first 30 minutes settle; wait for the 15-minute close, not the first print. Limit orders at the mid.
